items.headline: Molecule adds physical gas via acquisition
items.summary: Molecule Software acquired Trilogy Energy Solutions, strengthening its cloud ETRM/CTRM platform's capabilities in physical gas operations, according to CTRM Center reporting.

items.headline: ACER consults on REMIT-EMIR reporting overlap
items.summary: ACER's public consultation on a new Annex clarifying how energy derivative transactions should be reported under REMIT versus EMIR closed September 11, with a finalized version expected by October 2026.

items.headline: Tanker freight costs hit record highs
items.summary: Reuters reported that shipping costs for the largest oil tankers reached record highs this week, adding pressure to crude trading and physical delivery economics amid ongoing conflict-related supply concerns.

items.headline: Commodity trade finance market set for growth
items.summary: A new market report projects the global commodity trade finance sector to expand from roughly $59.7bn in 2026 to $81.45bn by 2030, driven by fintech, blockchain settlement and structured finance innovation, particularly in Asia-Pacific.
